title: Men in black seen by trick-or-treaters

tellings.quote:
these two weird guys showed up in these
1920s outfits and they said, you know,
if you see something weird, they said
just close your eyes and tell it to
land."

plain: Sometime between 1983 and 1986 in southeast New York, children out trick-or-treating are said to have met two strange men dressed in 1920s clothes, who told them that if they ever saw something weird, they should close their eyes and tell it to land. Charles Buhler, an engineer who has worked with NASA, tells the story as something passed on to him, in the tradition of the so-called men in black who are said to appear around UFO sightings.
